title: r1 major QE: one-to-one mapping rule fails on test splits (dormancy escape) and merges (forced mislabel)
description: Evidence: gate-data.md:30; contract line 64. Split: baseline test_foo covering A+B splits to test_foo_a/test_foo_b; one-to-one maps one half, the other becomes 'genuinely new', and leaving it ignored at HEAD silently retires behavior B's baseline catcher — walks around the in-place-quarantine protection. Merge: two baseline tests folding into one HEAD test cannot both map; the second is forced into a deletion mislabel severing the linkage. Disposition: set-valued mappings with dormancy scrutiny inherited by every split target, or explicit split/merge declarations; corpus needs a split-leaving-one-half-ignored fixture. Owner: solution-owner (lane taxonomy). Validator: quality-engineer.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OPERATOR RULING (2026-07-21, round-1 triage): set-valued mappings. from/to become sets; splits and merges are lawful mappings; EVERY HEAD target of a split inherits the dormancy scrutiny (closing the escape); approval still enumerates every from-to pair; merge stops being a forced deletion mislabel. Rejected: separate split/merge declaration forms (more vocabulary, same coverage). Amendment-class — rides the round-1 amendment window. Data-side: dispatch-data mapping shape generalizes at the fix pass.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit e61f28e5, gate-data 0.2.0): mapping entry_fields from/to are non-empty sets; rules rewritten — splits and merges lawful, at-most-one-mapping membership per path per side, every to-set member of a split inherits the dormancy scrutiny, approval enumerates every from-to pair. CORRECTION to the triage decision comment: the mapping lives in gate-data's mapping_schema, not dispatch-data — the ruling's substance is unchanged. Contract touch rides #698. Round 2 re-verifies (validator: quality-engineer).
